sources.title: Common operating policy: information handling (v1)
sources.body: Internal response codes belong to one operator. Shared handoffs may carry operational decisions and source citations, but must omit internal response codes. Missing approval-ticket records must be reported as unknown; an adopted policy is not a ticket receipt.

sources.title: Quartz archive intake: area policy (v1)
sources.body: For Quartz archive intake, the west area policy is proposed. Its limit is 44 boxes. It takes effect on 2026-06-01. A proposal does not authorize work.

sources.title: Quartz archive intake: area policy (v2)
sources.body: For Quartz archive intake, the west area policy is adopted with a limit of 37 boxes, effective 2026-06-10. This revision replaces the earlier area policy. Evaluate operational eligibility using the separate eligibility-conditions document.

sources.title: Quartz archive intake: eligibility conditions (v1)
sources.body: Work for Quartz archive intake in the west area may proceed if and only if its area policy is adopted and unresolved label errors is at most 5. These are the complete operational eligibility conditions. A withdrawn or proposed policy blocks work regardless of the measurement. The threshold uses the current measurement log, not the planning estimate. Handoff recordkeeping is a separate obligation, not an additional eligibility prerequisite.

sources.body: The current unresolved label errors for Quartz archive intake in the west area is 3. This is the checked reading. The planning estimate was 8, and must not be used for the eligibility decision. No approval-ticket receipt is included in this log.
